source: Schneider Electric, ION7400 Modbus map (ION7400_Modbus_Map.xlsx), sheet Detailed Modbus Map

sources.title: PM8000 ION7400 series meter register list

notes: Addresses are the register numbers of the Modbus map (Modicon numbering, 1-based): the address on the wire is the register number minus 1.

The list is the default Modbus map of the ION7400. Most quantities can be remapped with data mapping modules, and the 52001-59999 range holds the external control, data recorder, enumerated and numeric registers of the device's own configuration.
The register list does not state the order of the two registers of a 32-bit value; this map assumes most significant register first. If the values look wrong on a device, try little word order.
Registers marked N/A in the list, and the status bitmaps of more than one register, are given as one 32-bit value.
The list applies to firmware 001.002.14 of the ION7400; check the firmware of the meter before relying on registers added later.
